engine.note: draw at whole-number zoom (480x270 x4 = 1920x1080); never filter the plate

qa.method: hibit_plate v1 (forge_hibit, the hi-bit studio recipe): cover crop of the painting to the plate aspect; one palette (k-means++ on luminance-weighted RGB, or a given palette); every source pixel indexed to its nearest palette colour and every plate pixel the colour covering most of its cell (majority, never a blend); forge_hibit.clean_isolated (lone pixels take the 4-neighbour majority unless 90 apart in luminance-weighted RGB); 3x3 majority smoothing passes; opaque; nearest preview only for review
notProven: That the painting reads as the intended scene at the plate size (look at plate-x4.png at gameplay scale).
That characters and FX read against it: finish the sprites with their own palettes and look at a mock-up.
Where the walkable ground is: the tool does not find the floor line in the art.

checks.note: share of plate pixels with no 4-neighbour of their colour (kept features: lights, stars, eyes)
painting px per plate px; under 2x the majority has little to vote
